neighbours.label: the word 'literally' as a casual intensifier (' literally', 'Liter'+'ally'), firing on the word; 'honestly', 'really' and the like in the same frames stay low
fire: I have never been so tired after a hike, literally ever.
She was crying and laughing at the same time. Literally.
Literally everyone in this town owns a boat.
That new job saved my marriage, literally.
We literally waited four hours for a table.
My brother is literally the worst cook alive.
It was so cold you could literally see your breath indoors.
He literally ran out of the room when he heard.
quiet: I have never been so tired after a hike, honestly ever.
She was crying and laughing at the same time. Really.
Nearly everyone in this town owns a boat.
That new job saved my marriage, truly.
We actually waited four hours for a table.
My brother is simply the worst cook alive.
It was so cold you could clearly see your breath indoors.
He quickly ran out of the room when he heard.
